title: Freedom's Future 2026: more than 500 children celebrate Independence Day
summary: More than 500 children from orphanages and local churches joined our Independence Day celebration on July 26, 2026.
body:
On July 26, 2026, more than 500 children from orphanages and local churches in underserved communities joined Freedom's Future, White Heart Initiative's Independence Day celebration.

What happened

Through mentorship sessions, educational and entertainment activities, we kept children in a safe space while teaching them the true value of Liberia's independence.

As part of the event, we also reached out to orphanages in need with food, mattresses, school bags, books and stationery.

Four years of Freedom's Future

  • 2023: more than 200 children

  • 2024: more than 300 children

  • 2025: more than 600 children

  • 2026: more than 500 children

The next Freedom's Future takes place on July 26, 2027. Find out how to partner with us.
